headline: 新書：身體史與殘障史
context: 兩本歷史新書這週受到書評關注。艾琳・麥格拉克（Erin Maglaque）的《Presence: A Hidden History of the Female Body》從碎片化的史料重建近代早期女性的身體歷史，獲得正面評價。大衛・特納（David Turner）的《Disability》聚焦殘障人士爭取權利的歷史，以引人入勝的個人故事為亮點。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: This study of the struggle for rights includes incredible personal stories that we should all be more familiar with You could take two outwardly contradictory lessons from the historian David Turner’s new book on disability in the UK. First, that alarmingly little has changed for disabled people since the beginning of the modern age (the book’s first few stories, of 17th-century men and women having to prove they were disabled enough to receive parish support to avoid starvation, will be familiar to anyone who has tried to claim the personal independence payment). And second, that absolutely everything has changed - from the closing of asylums to the advent of prosthetics to the eventual, belated enshrining of disability rights in law. But the central argument of Disability helps to reconcile these two narratives into a coherent whole. Turner, a professor at Swansea University, shows that while public and political attitudes to disability have remained poor, disabled people have challenged them at every stage, wresting progress out of even the most unpromising circumstances. This is not a story of rights and dignity bestowed from on high, but of the people and communities clawing them into being. Continue reading...

thread_text:
🧵 1/N
📌 八大藝術

新書：身體史與殘障史

兩本歷史新書。艾琳・麥格拉克（Erin Maglaque）的《Presence: A Hidden History of the Female Body》從早期現代史料碎片重建女性身體史，書評給予好評。大衛・特納（David Turner）的《Disability》是殘障人士爭取權利的歷史，書中的個人故事被評論稱道。

—— 本則整理自 The New York Times 及 The Guardian 於 2026 年 6 月 19 日發佈的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
兩本新出版的歷史書這週受到書評關注。艾琳・麥格拉克（Erin Maglaque）的《Presence: A Hidden History of the Female Body》從近代早期女性的史料碎片重建身體歷史，書評給予好評。大衛・特納（David Turner）的《Disability》則是關於殘障人士爭取權利的研究，以個人故事為亮點。

本則整理自 The New York Times 及 The Guardian 於 2026 年 6 月 19 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 書評這邊，兩本新的歷史書。麥格拉克的《Presence》，試圖從史料碎片重建近代早期女性的身體歷史，書評給予肯定。特納的《Disability》是殘障人士爭取權利的歷史，書中收錄了不少個人故事，被認為很有感染力。
